d.title: Futari wa Precure: Splash☆Star Maji★Doki♥ Theater
d.jp: ふたりはプリキュア Splash Star マジッ★ドキッ♥ シアター
syn: Pretty Cure Splash Star Magic Doki 3D Theater Movie
d.synopsis: A seed of hope descends from the sky, landing atop Flappy's head and sprouting between his ears. Goyaan is sent after the seed of hope and uses a seed of despair to transform an Uzaina, causing big trouble for the Precure!
